author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Is it difficult to separate prop reference photos from AI? Now that he and Mrs Donttrythis are empty nesters, will they leave San Francisco? If Adam Savage could add any Met artifact to his collection, what would it be? Are there any skills Adam will stop pursuing and just leave to AI? How does Adam balance "productive" time with "zoning out" time? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Scarborough_Gatekeeper, jordonfreeman, DFriendly, DanielBally and nicholasozorak2931, whom we thank for their support!

00:00 AI Photos
00:59 Empty Nest
01:30 The Met
04:46 AI or Skills
10:44 Zoning Out
